title.zh: 独立、透明、用晚高峰数据检验每一条专线
title.en: Independent, Transparent, and Peak-Data Driven Benchmark

intro.zh: FreeVPN 实测实验室 创立于 2021 年。面对网络上铺天盖地的“永久免费VPN”诱饵软件与劣质中转节点，我们致力于建立一套透明、可复现、基于晚高峰网络拥堵环境的第三方测速标准。我们不接受任何虚假好评操控，只通过机器实测图谱与真实节点延迟说话。
intro.en: FreeVPN Benchmark Lab was established in 2021. In an internet saturated with suspicious 'free VPN' claims, we build reproducible, real-world peak-congestion benchmark standards. No sponsored bias—only verifiable bandwidth charts and TLS round-trip latencies.

contentRight.zh: 我们的使命是帮助每一个需要跨境查阅学术资料、远程办公、TikTok 跨境电商直播和海外 AI 创作的用户，彻底避开“限速套路”、“日志滥用”和“跑路风险”。每一份评测均覆盖香港、日本、新加坡、美国等核心节点，并对 4K 流媒体与 ChatGPT/Claude 原生解锁能力进行交叉验证。
contentRight.en: Our mission is to help developers, creators, cross-border e-commerce sellers, and researchers bypass deceptive bandwidth throttling and privacy leaks. We test connections across Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, and US nodes, verifying 4K streaming and native AI unlocks.

contentLast.zh: 技术与中立性 是我们坚守的核心原则。我们所有的数据采集流程均保持透明，对 42 家机场品牌资料中缺少独立测试支撑的部分均严格标记为【品牌资料提供 / 待核实】。我们坚信，只有真实可靠的信息增量，才能赢得用户的长久信任。
contentLast.en: Integrity and Neutrality define our principles. Any unverified marketing claim is transparently flagged as vendor-provided. We believe that long-term user trust is earned exclusively through uncompromising technical honesty.

animationContent.zh: 探索 42 家主流机场科学测速天梯图，寻找专属于你的超高速跨境加速方案。
animationContent.en: Explore our 42-brand speed ladder and find the high-speed line tailored to your workflow.
